title: Optimizing Container Loading and Unloading through Dual-Cycling and Dockyard Rehandle Reduction Using a Hybrid Genetic Algorithm
abstract: arXiv:2406.08534v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper addresses the NP-hard problem of optimizing container handling at ports by integrating Quay Crane Dual-Cycling (QCDC) and dockyard rehandle minimization. We realized that there are interdependencies between the unloading sequence of QCDC and the dockyard plan and propose the Quay Crane Dual Cycle - Dockyard Rehandle Genetic Algorithm (QCDC-DR-GA), a hybrid Genetic Algorithm (GA) that holistically optimizes both aspects: maximizing the number of Dual Cycles (DCs) and minimizing the number of dockyard rehandles. QCDC-DR-GA employs specialized crossover and mutation strategies. translated_title: 通过双循环与堆场重吊减少优化集装箱装卸：基于混合遗传算法的方法
translated_abstract: 本文针对港口集装箱处理的NP难问题，通过整合岸桥双循环（QCDC）和堆场重吊最小化来优化操作。我们认识到QCDC的卸载顺序与堆场计划之间存在相互依赖性，并提出了一种混合遗传算法——岸桥双循环-堆场重吊遗传算法（QCDC-DR-GA），该算法全面优化这两个方面：最大化双循环（DCs）数量并最小化堆场重吊次数。QCDC-DR-GA采用了专门的交叉和变异策略。在不同船型上的广泛实验表明，与现有方法相比，QCDC-DR-GA在大型船舶上将总操作时间减少了15-20%。通过双尾配对t检验进行的统计验证确认了在5%显著性水平上的显著改进。结果强调了孤立优化的低效性，并突出了整体优化方法的优势。
tldr: 本文提出一种混合遗传算法（QCDC-DR-GA），通过联合优化岸桥双循环和堆场重吊，显著提升港口装卸效率，在大型船舶上减少15-20%的操作时间。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid genetic algorithm (QCDC-DR-GA) that jointly optimizes quay crane dual-cycling and dockyard rehandles, significantly improving port efficiency with a 15-20% reduction in operation time for large ships.
